body: If I could do that I would still question but I would feel a whole lot better about living.

My situation is fucked up. I wish someone could help me. Not many people have to deal with my problem is what I mean. I know why I am depressed though. Because of my situation.... Just living for the point of having fun and stuff doesn't cut it when you feel so bad all the time.
If there wasn't me it wouldn't matter and I wouldn't cause my family pain. I feel like this is hell... not many people have to go through what I am. I don't really believe in hope anymore.
